_howto: The homepage feed mixes upcoming events, the Daily Word, videos, the podcast and these posts. Add your own posts (Facebook, Instagram, announcements) to "posts" — newest date shows first. platform can be: facebook, instagram, youtube, substack, site. url and image are optional. The "auto" list is filled every day by generate-social-feed.js (YouTube uploads + Substack posts) — don't edit it by hand.

posts.text: New on the site: videos & shorts. Watch "There's a Seat for You" and three new shorts.
